caption: The drawing features a single, large brown jug with a pronounced round body, a narrower neck, and a wide rim at the top. The jug has a single, thick handle attached to its right side, curving outward and then attaching near the rim and shoulder of the vessel. The surface of the jug is decorated with randomly spaced, dark brown irregular patches. The object is placed on a flat, horizontal wooden surface that has visible grain patterns rendered in shades of brown, suggesting the texture of the wood. The background behind the jug is a plain, light beige color with no additional elements or decorations. The colors in the composition primarily consist of various browns, with some highlights and shadows to suggest light falling from the left side.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
